content.json:
# Backup & DR compliance
Azure Backup coverage and Site Recovery health across the selected subscriptions. Source: Azure Resource Graph, so results are near real time and need only Reader access.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where tostring(tags['backup-exempt']) != 'true'
| project vmId = tolower(id), subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | where tostring(properties.workloadType) =~ 'VM'
    | where tostring(properties.protectionState) in~ ('Protected', 'IRPending', 'ProtectionError')
    | project vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId)), protected = 1
) on vmId
| summarize totalVms = count(), protectedVms = countif(protected == 1) by subscriptionId
| extend coveragePct = round(100.0 * protectedVms / totalVms, 1)
| order by coveragePct asc
content.title: Coverage by subscription

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where tostring(tags['backup-exempt']) != 'true'
| project vmId = tolower(id), vmName = name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, environment = tostring(tags['environment'])
| join kind=leftouter (
    recoveryservicesresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | where tostring(properties.workloadType) =~ 'VM'
    | project vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId)), protectionState = tostring(properties.protectionState), lastBackupStatus = tostring(properties.lastBackupStatus), lastBackupTime = todatetime(properties.lastBackupTime)
) on vmId
| where isempty(protectionState) or protectionState =~ 'ProtectionStopped' or lastBackupStatus =~ 'Failed' or lastBackupTime < ago(26h)
| extend issue = case(isempty(protectionState), 'Unprotected', protectionState =~ 'ProtectionStopped', 'Stopped', lastBackupStatus =~ 'Failed', 'Failed', 'Stale')
| project vmName, issue, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, environment, lastBackupTime
| order by issue asc, vmName asc
content.title: VMs that need action

content.query:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/replicationfabrics/replicationprotectioncontainers/replicationprotecteditems'
| project vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.fabricObjectId)),
          asrVault = tostring(split(id, '/')[8]),
          replicationHealth = tostring(properties.replicationHealth),
          asrProtectionState = tostring(properties.protectionState),
          rpoSeconds = toint(properties.providerSpecificDetails.rpoInSeconds),
          lastTestFailover = tostring(properties.lastSuccessfulTestFailoverTime)
| where isnotempty(vmId)
content.title: Site Recovery replication health
